description: This file defines the ManyToManyRelationship class which manages metadata for a many-to-many relationship in SuiteCRM. It extends an abstract relationship class and provides methods to build subpanel definitions, vardefs, and relationship metadata.

classes.name: ManyToManyRelationship
classes.description: Handles metadata for a many-to-many relationship between modules, including building subpanel definitions, vardefs, and relationship metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ManyToManyRelationship object with the provided relationship definition.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Creates subpanel configurations for the involved modules based on the relationship.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Builds vardef array entries for the relationship link fields in each module.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Generates relationship metadata definitions for the involved modules.
